entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Could not load file or assembly 'System.IO.Pipelines' in Visual Studio 2022 when using System.Text.Json #80811
  • Semantic classification unavailable due to IndexOutOfRangeException in VirtualCharSequenceSourceText.CopyTo #80808

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11117.08 #80806

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix RemoveUnusedMembers handling of default parameter reads #80810
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • soft-select select camelcase matched item if user might be typing an … #80809
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Ensure that locals at the top level of a constructor have the same safe-context as parameters #80807
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Add several tests for collection expressions with ref struct element type #80593
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Allow foreach on typed null enumerables #80783
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix culture-sensitive StringBuilder.Append calls across compiler codebase #80800
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix go to definition for conversions on invalid constructor overloads #78514
    Area-Compilers, Need More Info, Community, untriaged
  • Improve error reporting for 'with(...)' argument diagnostics. Address several PROTOTYPE comments. #80805
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • Add analyzer/fixer to remove unnecessary 'unsafe' modifiers from members. #80794
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
    Area-Compilers
